meta.title: Feedback and reports | Sefinek
meta.description: How to send feedback, report a bug or share an idea about my apps, tools and projects, including during closed testing.

heading: Feedback and reports
intro: Using my apps, tools or websites? Testing one of my projects before release? Your feedback, bug reports and ideas help me improve them.

send.title: How to send feedback
send.text: Get in touch using one of the options on my contact page. You will find my email address and links to my Discord server and GitHub profile there. I usually reply within 24-48 hours.

include.title: What to include in a bug report
items: The name of the project, app or website you are writing about.
The app version and the device and operating system you use. If you are reporting a website issue, also include your browser name and version.
Bug reproduction. A description of the problem and steps to reproduce it.
What you expected to happen instead.
A screenshot, recording or log excerpt, if possible.

kinds.title: What you can share
items: Ideas for new features and improvements.
Unclear wording, translation errors and typos.
Feedback on design, usability and performance.

note: Before leaving a review on Google Play, I encourage you to get in touch. Tell me what you find difficult, what is missing or what you would like to change in the app. A conversation helps me understand the problem, ask for details and make useful improvements. Your suggestions help me build a better app. I use the data you send to handle your report, as described in the [privacy policy]({{privacyUrl}}).
